# Styles

All the CSS: Tailwind v4 setup, design tokens, and custom styles.

## What's here

- `main.css`: the entry point that imports everything else
- `colors.css`, `typography/fontFamilies.css`: generated from Figma, don't hand-edit
- `base.css`, `sizes.css`: resets and size tokens
- `decorations.css` and `backgrounds/`: patterns, gel, overlays, media treatments
- `components/`: hanko seal and rich-text styles
- `utilities/`: masks, text helpers, reduced-motion and debug outlines
- `typography/`: font loading

## Good to know

Import order in `main.css` matters: fonts first, then Tailwind, base, theme, components. Don't run the Tailwind CLI directly; use `npm start` or `npm run build:css`.

## How it connects

- `scripts/buildCSS.js` compiles `main.css` into the site.
- [figma](../figma/README.figma.md) generates the token files.
